capabilities: Chat with vault notes in a side panel with streaming and editable messages
Pull notes into the prompt via wikilinks, the active note, or keyword search
Save chat replies or selections as notes with frontmatter
Configure multiple providers and models and switch between them
Autosave conversations as Markdown files in the vault
extras: Marked beta; semantic search, agents, and a local privacy layer are on the roadmap. Manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. Install requires manual file placement or BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI model about your notes or turn chat replies back into permanent notes.

relations.evidence: Or via BRAT: Add beta plugin

requires.name: Ollama or LM Studio for local models

summary: AI chat plugin that answers questions about your vault using Gemini, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible model, with note context and replies saved as notes.
